decision.reason: The only evidence is a one-line CLI changelog title [ev-a228b19b23ac]. It says workload identity support for remote clusters was added (RFC-0010), but it points to PR #5434 for the details. It does not name the mechanism that turns this on, such as a CLI flag, an API field, a kubeconfig/secret setting or a feature gate. Without that, an engineer cannot write a condition for which environments are exposed. The RFC-0010 text, the PR description or the docs saying how remote-cluster workload identity is configured are needed.
